title: Co-training identifies a high-efficiency Cr-activated NIR phosphor
summary: Semi-supervised co-training with kernel ridge regression and support-vector regression expanded the labeled phosphor dataset and selected Lu3Y2Ga3O12:Cr3+. The study reports emission near 750 nm with internal and external quantum efficiencies of 97.1% and 38.8%, respectively, and a fabricated laboratory phosphor-converted LED. The abstract’s values are author-reported laboratory measurements, not commercial product performance.

evidence.tested: Primary publisher article reports synthesized candidate, emission/efficiencies and laboratory pc-LED.
evidence.unknown: Prior composition-level disclosures and independent device durability are not established.
evidence.ai_role: Co-training predicts emission peak and screens candidate garnet compositions for experimental synthesis.

source_review.scope: Primary source checked for identity, date, model role and bounded reported result.
